title: Parrot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dancing parrot -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='66' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='14' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='14' fill='#3ee07e' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='38' r='5' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='30' r='4' fill='#f5f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='30' r='2' fill='#7b4bd8'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M71 32 q9 3 0 9 q-2 -4 0 -9 z' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <path d='M71 36 q6 3 0 5 z' fill='#e67e22'/>
  <!-- crest feathers -->
  <path d='M52 22 q-2 -12 6 -14 q-3 8 2 12 z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M57 20 q1 -12 9 -12 q-5 7 -3 12 z' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <path d='M62 20 q4 -10 11 -8 q-6 5 -6 11 z' fill='#3498db'/>
  <!-- wing raised (dancing) -->
  <path d='M32 50 q-16 -10 -18 -22 q10 6 22 10 z' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <path d='M32 50 q-10 -6 -14 -14 q6 4 14 6 z' fill='#1e8449'/>
  <!-- wing tip feathers -->
  <path d='M14 28 q-4 -6 0 -8 q3 3 4 7 z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M18 26 q-3 -7 1 -9 q3 3 3 8 z' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- second wing -->
  <path d='M66 58 q14 -2 18 -12 q-8 4 -16 4 z' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <path d='M84 46 q4 -5 1 -7 q-3 2 -4 6 z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d='M36 82 q-8 10 -6 18 q8 -6 10 -16 z' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <path d='M42 84 q-4 12 0 16 q4 -6 4 -14 z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M48 84 q2 12 8 14 q-2 -10 -4 -14 z' fill='#3498db'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M42 84 q-6 4 -10 2' stroke='#f39c12' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 84 q6 6 12 4' stroke='#f39c12' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 86 l-6 0 l4 -3 z' fill='#e67e22'/>
  <path d='M66 88 l6 -1 l-4 -3 z' fill='#e67e22'/>
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='18' r='2' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='22' r='2' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='64' r='2' fill='#3ee07e'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='60' r='2' fill='#3ee07e'/>
  <path d='M76 14 l2 4 l-4 -1 z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
</svg>
